chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdullah ibn Jundab, from Sufyan ibn al-Simt, who said:
I asked Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) about the Revelation of the Quran. He (peace be upon him) said: 'Recite it just as you were taught.'
ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about the authenticity of the Quran's text regarding revelations?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Sufyan ibn al-Simt inquires about the integrity of the Quranic text amidst the era of Occultation, to which Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) responds with 'Recite as you were taught.' This directive emphasizes the validity of the widely transmitted (Mutawatir) readings and the practical authority of the community's memorization, reassuring believers that the Quran remains accessible and authentic for worship despite scholarly debates on minor textual variations.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdullah Bin Jundab, from Sufyan Bin Al Simt who said,

‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the Revelation of the Quran. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Recite it just as you learnt it’. (i.e. – ignore the alterations in the meantime before the rising of Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup>).
en.sarwar: 15. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn al- Hakam from ‘Abd Allah ibn Jundab from Sufyan ibn al-Samt who has said the following: “Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) ‘How was the Holy Quran revealed?’
The Imam said, ‘Read as you are instructed.’”
